item.title: CVE-2026-129453 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Sunday 15 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | A vulnerability was found in DrayTek Vigor2960 1.5.1.6. This issue affects the function check_file_exist of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi of the component File Existence Check. Performing a manipulation of the argument upload_name results in heap-based buffer overflow. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 is capable of addressing this issue. Upgrading the affected component is recommended. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

item.title: CVE-2026-129477 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 15 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the glTF and glTF2 importers that allows attackers to read local files via crafted buffers[].uri values. Attackers can supply glTF models with '..' segments or absolute paths in buffer URIs to load files like /etc/passwd into imported mesh vertex data.

item.title: CVE-2026-129478 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 15 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in glTFCommon::Util::ParseDataURI caused by storing the data offset in a signed char. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF file with a raw data URI whose segment starts beyond byte 127 to crash applications or leak adjacent heap memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-129479 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 15 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in OgreBinarySerializer::ReadSubMesh that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying crafted Ogre binary .mesh files. Attackers can set a large index count so the 32-bit buffer size wraps, causing a segmentation fault in aiMesh::~aiMesh() during scene teardown.

item.title: CVE-2026-129480 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8
item.description: Sunday 15 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8 | Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in MD2Importer::InternReadFile that allows attackers to read past the file buffer via an unvalidated stored frameSize header field. Attackers can supply a crafted .md2 file loaded with a non-zero keyframe selected to crash the application or leak adjacent heap memory into the imported mesh.

item.description: Sunday 15 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | OkHttp through 5.5.1 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in CertificatePinner that skips pin checks because Pin.matchesHostname does not normalize trailing-dot hostnames. item.description: Sunday 15 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | Cyrus SASL through 2.1.28 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the SRP server mechanism because srp_server_mech_step2 does not reject client public values A that are multiples of N. item.title: CVE-2025-71466 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 15 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC before 26.02.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in m2tsdmx_update_sdt() in src/filters/dmx_m2ts.c that allows attackers to crash the MPEG-2 TS demuxer. item.title: CVE-2025-71467 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 15 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC before 26.02.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_node_get_field_by_name() in src/scenegraph/base_scenegraph.c that lets attackers crash applications. item.title: CVE-2025-71468 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 15 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC before 26.02.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_dash_group_get_audio_channels() in src/media_tools/dash_client.c that allows attackers to crash applications via crafted DASH manifests. item.title: CVE-2025-71469 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8

item.title: CVE-2026-129490 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 15 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | littlefs through 2.11.3, when built with LFS_MIGRATE, contains a type confusion vulnerability in lfs_dir_traverse() that treats a stack lfs_diskoff struct as an lfs_attr array. Attackers can supply a crafted littlefs v1 image whose metadata is read as LFS_FROM_USERATTRS during migration, causing out-of-bounds stack reads and process crashes.
